verses.text_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
verses.transliteration: Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi ashaabil feel

translations.text: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?

verses.transliteration: Alam yaj'al kai dahum fee tad leel

translations.text: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
And He sent against them birds in flocks,

verses.transliteration: Tar meehim bi hi jaaratim min sij jeel

translations.text: Striking them with stones of hard clay,
And He made them like eaten straw.
